steps.content: Greatly outnumbered, the outcome of the brawl comes as no surprise.
Ropes coil around her body, tightening into knots... Korryn hums a tune as she deftly bounds Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So many of you ganging up on me! Have you no shame?! So you've won, fine! But why tie me up? You gonna sell me off, too?!
Hella pauses, then completely gives up and lies flat.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha! Go ahead then, sell me. If you've got the guts, sell me to a place far, far away!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I'm telling you, Horo's Legion and the MBCC love me! Messing with me is messing with them!
Korryn chuckles and stops her tying.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh, now that you mention it, that does seem to be the case, huh?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So, my dear Hella, what should I do to escape this tragic fate...?
Hella's eyes dart around, deliberately putting on a wary, panicked expression.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wh-what are you thinking? You're not planning to keep me hostage, are you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No! You can't do that! They care too much about me! I would become their weak spot! I can't be a hostage!
To her surprise, Korryn bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hahaha! You can be a hostage, then! We're really short on helpers lately, so from now on, you can go with Wright to organize the depot!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, hold on! I'm a hostage, not a laborer! Why do I have to work for you guys?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hehe, little Hella, that's not the right description...
Korryn lowers her hat brim slightly, her expression mysterious.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Do you think we'd pay you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Eh... No.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Exactly. Since there's no pay, you aren't working for us.
Korryn picks up Hella, unties her, and pushes her into the depot.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: From now on, you're a little damsel in distress captured by the Tuco villains. You're not in a position to refuse! Feel free to surrender anytime.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Y-you bastard! I'll tell the Legion Commander! I'll tell the BBQ-C! I won't surrender!!
The door slams shut, followed by a set of tools thrown in through the window.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Alright, alright, I'll surrender tomorrow, and start working for you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=38>Hmph, fine, I'll work. What a bunch of idiots. You dare keep Hella hostage? Just wait and see! I'll get back at you all at once!</size>
